headline: A 1998 executive order created a President's Council on Food Safety within the federal government.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order set up a council focused on food safety at the federal level. Only the title is available, so details about the council's members, duties, and powers are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that work on food safety
who_it_affects.how: They would likely take part in or coordinate through the new council, though the specific role is not stated in the available material.
